notes.title: NEW game playtest is OUT NOW! Dystopian Debugger
notes.notes:
The playtest for Dystopian Debugger is now LIVE: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144800/Dystopian_Debugger/

Dystopian Debugger is a puzzle game about debugging murderous robots! 

Today, you can try out the cyberpunk coding game that's suitable both for complete beginners and those, who have already dipped their toes in coding.
Get a taste of the story with choices that can even affect your gameplay!

Key Features of Dystopian Debugger Playtest:
 
[olist]
[*]2 available coding languages - Robo and Turtle
[*]3 playable days + Tutorial
[*]1 day Story preview
[*]Kinetic playing experience - you'll be moving between several apparatus, as you'll be coding, testing, checking and submitting your programs!
[/olist]
[i]Keep in mind the build is a WIP and almost everything is subject to change.[/i]

notes.title: Who's Lila Demo is out!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=guDhLF4ZKoM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]"It's difficult for me to express emotions.
I envy other people. They make faces naturally, but I have to make a conscious decision each time I move a muscle.
Every morning I go to the bathroom to rehearse what my face is going to show today. "[/i]

Who's Lila? is a reverse-detective point-and-click adventure. It is an [b]AI-powered[/b] choice-driven game, where instead of choosing dialogue options, you have full control over the character's face.
Will you solve the enigmatic mystery? Will you be able to tackle your own emotions in pursuit of your mysterious goals?
And finally, will you find the answer to the ultimate question - Who is Lila?


[b]Note: if you encounter an emotion detected wrong - please feel free to screenshot it and send it to me (preferrably by this e-mail: GarageHeathen@yandex.ru)[/b]
